Centro Storico (Duomo, Signoria) — Florence, Italy

🟡 Local press research

In detail

The historic centre (Duomo/Piazza della Signoria area) is, in absolute numbers, Florence's highest-crime area — a Fondazione Caponnetto report counted 418 microcrime episodes here in six months, versus far fewer in every other district, attributed explicitly to the density of tourism and commerce. The overwhelming majority of this is non-violent pickpocketing and petty theft targeting tourists (numerous forum complaints, arrests of theft crews inside Palazzo Vecchio), not violent crime. Separately, a large brawl involving chairs and tables, followed by a stabbing, broke out in Piazza del Duomo on New Year's Eve 2025 into 2026 — a serious but crowd/event-linked outlier rather than a nightly occurrence. Sources checked: La Nazione, Fondazione Caponnetto six-month microcrime report (Quartiere 1: 418 episodes); GoNews, mass brawl and stabbing in Piazza del Duomo, New Year's Eve 2025/26; FirenzeToday, organised pickpocket gang targeting tourists near Palazzo Vecchio.
